policy: The main master hot path must be selected by machine search and lowered through reusable compiler primitives. A descriptor or manifest label around a human-authored kernel body is not machine search.

current_gate.audit_gap: The gate trusts route_manifest provenance labels and overlay commentary; it does not validate the executing source closure, generator identity, search input/output hashes, generated-file immutability, or evidence existence.

strict_result.interpretation: Zero routes currently satisfy the new end-to-end proof contract. This is a provenance result, not a claim that all nine kernels were necessarily selected by humans.

routes.reason: The Python source manually constructs the UOp loop, lane map, loads, accumulation, reduction, and store; no generator/search-run artifact proves that source was emitted from machine search.
A dataclass wraps a hand-written lowering and dequant grammar. Descriptor ownership alone does not prove machine search authored the executable topology.
flash_kernels.py manually owns the complete route-local load/LDS/online-softmax/PV/store lifecycle. A FlashDecodeAttentionSpec wrapper does not change kernel authorship.
It shares the same hand-authored executable tile/combine closure as G4; a separate route identity and geometry guard are not generation provenance.
tinygrad/schedule/wmma/kernels.py explicitly identifies itself as fixed-geometry hand kernels and manually constructs the full attention lifecycle.

The executing kernel is compiler-generated, but the selected candidate needs a complete public search-input, generator/run identity, candidate-output, and immutable binding chain before it can establish the main hot-path machine-search claim.
The route spec and lowering manually encode output layout, tiling, packed-load grammar, loops, and stores; no immutable search artifact owns the concrete choice.
The route mirrors a hand-authored lowering and reuses hand-authored packed-load helpers; the descriptor is not evidence that search authored the implementation.
The kernel body is scheduler-generated, but PACKED_WMMA_GEOM is a frozen manually copied table with no reproducible search provenance; the repository's own 20260725 claim scope records this gap.

master_forbidden_examples: model/shape-specific Python functions that build UOp kernel loops
manual tile/warp/LDS/WMMA geometry tables presented as search output
raw HIP/CUDA/C/ASM or precompiled route kernels
hand-authored custom-kernel rollback implementations, even when default-off
master_allowed: model-agnostic reusable compiler and backend primitives
immutable generated route plans/artifacts with verified search provenance
runtime selection, artifact validation, and fail-closed dispatch
ordinary tinygrad graph fallback for unsupported shapes
